info.name: Vidhilikhit Vedic Astrology API (v1)
info.description: Complete Postman Collection v2.1 for Vidhilikhit Vedic Astrology Backend API covering all 9 flows under /api/v1.

request.description: Registers a new user with terms accepted, creates active profile, and auto-saves token/profileId in Postman environment.
Authenticates user and returns JWT accessToken and refreshToken. The test script automatically stores the token in the environment.
Initiates password reset email flow.
Resets account password using single-use reset token.
Fetches authenticated user information and active profile ID.
Retrieves all family profiles for the current user and shows which is currently active.
Adds a family member profile (spouse, child, parent, sibling, partner, relative, friend).
Switches the active profile so that subsequent dashboard and kundali calculations reflect this family member.
Updates details of a family profile.
Deletes a family profile.
Fetches home dashboard greeting, active Mahadasha, daily horoscope glimpse, panchang snippet, and quick actions.
Fetches home dashboard with fully localized Marathi greeting, Kundali card (Rashi, Lagna), Daily Panchang snippet (Tithi, Nakshatra, Abhijit Muhurat), and Vidhilikhit Bot banner in Marathi.

item.name: Flow 4: My Kundali (Calculations & Charts - Phase 1 Enhanced)
4.1 Kundali Overview & Chart (Includes Panchang, Avakhada, BirthDetails)

request.description: Returns profile, summary (rashi, nakshatra, lagna), D1 whole-sign chart with SVG URL, and Phase 1 additive objects: birthDetails (gender, ISO dates, UTC birth datetime, structured place), panchang (tithi name/number/paksha, karana, yoga, nakshatra lord/pada, sunrise/sunset, ayanamsa), avakhada (varna, vashya, yoni, gana, nadi, rashi, rashiLord, charan, tatva, nameAlphabet, paya, yunja), and calculation metadata.

item.name: 4.2 Graha Positions (9 Planets with Speeds, Lords & Dignity Booleans)

request.description: Returns real ephemeris positions for all 9 grahas (Sun through Ketu). Includes Phase 1 additive fields: signLord, nakshatraLord, nakshatraPada, longitudeDegrees, latitudeDegrees, dailyMotionDegrees (speed), isExalted, isDebilitated, isOwnSign, isMoolatrikona booleans, and structured combustion object with orbDegrees.

item.name: 4.3 Bhavas (12 Houses with Cusps, House Lords, Aspects & Strength)

request.description: Analyzes all 12 houses (bhavas), resident grahas, Parashari Rahu/Ketu analysis, and Phase 1 additive fields: cusp (longitudeDegrees, degreeInSign), houseLord (planet, houseNumber, sign), aspects (grahas casting Drishti), strength (total, rupas, ratio, rank), and interpretation (summary, positiveFactors, challengeFactors).

Returns all 18 Parashari Shodashavarga divisional charts: D1 (Rashi), D2 (Hora), D3 (Drekkana), D4 (Chaturthamsha), D6 (Shashtamsha), D7 (Saptamsha), D8 (Ashtamsha), D9 (Navamsha), D10 (Dashamsha), D12 (Dwadashamsha), D16 (Shodasamsha), D20 (Vimsamsha), D24 (Chaturvimshamsha), D27 (Saptavimshamsha), D30 (Trimsamsha), D40 (Khavedamsha), D45 (Akshavedamsha), and D60 (Shashtiamsha), each with chartSvg, chartData, and calculationStatus.

Detects classical Vedic planetary yogas (Gaja Kesari, Budhaditya, Chandra-Mangal, Raja, Upachaya, etc.). Includes Phase 1 additive fields: ruleCode, conditions array with evidence (planet, referencePlanet, houseDistance), housesInvolved array, structured interpretation (positiveIndications, cautions), and calculationStatus.

Returns currentMahadasha, currentAntardasha, upcomingAntardashas, plus Phase 1 additive full 120-year mahadashas array (with nested antardashas and isCurrent status) and timeline object (birthNakshatra, birthNakshatraLord, balanceAtBirth: planet, years, months, days).
Returns a standalone North Indian 12-house SVG vector diagram with exact zodiac sign numbers in each house cell and astrological planet symbols.
Returns 6-fold Shadbala virupas (Sthaana, Kaala, Diga, Cheshta, Naisargika, Drik), total virupas, rupas, required rupas, ratio, rank, and ishtaPhala for 7 planets, plus 12-house Bhavbala.
Returns real-time Gochar transit charts from both Lagna and Moon with SVG chart URLs, house placements, signs, and retrograde statuses.

item.name: 4.10 KP Astrology (Bhav Chalit, Sub-Lords & Ruling Planets)

request.description: Returns Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) Bhav Chalit chart, Ruling Planets, KP Grahas with Star Lords and Sub-Lords, and 12 KP Cusps.
Returns Sarvashtakavarga (SAV, summing to 337 bindus) and Bhinna Ashtakavarga (BAV) for the 7 classical planets across all 12 signs.
Evaluates Manglik Dosha checked from Lagna, Moon, and Venus; Kalsarpa Dosha along Rahu-Ketu axis; and active Sade Sati phase and timeline against natal Moon.
Provides Mukhi Rudraksha (1-9 Mukhi, ruling planet, deity, mantra, how to wear) and Gemstone recommendations (Life Stone, Lucky Stone, Fortune Stone with metals and mantras).
